R115_error_history_must_expire.rule: Any script that accumulates errors across runs (e.g., patch_error_history.json) must expire entries older than N runs before performing recurrence counting. Default N=10. Expiry logic: keep only history['errors'][-N*MAX_ERRORS_PER_RUN:] before calling Counter(). Without expiry, fixed errors re-trigger R024 prompts forever. The expiry slice must appear before Counter(), not after. Dead imports (re, unused) must also be absent — checked by the AST detector.
